thread:
lina_sales: Heads-up: prospect NovaTech asked for a POC access design that minimizes blast radius. Their checklist: ephemeral keys for contractors, ability to restrict to embeddings + chat, SSO-only onboarding, and a clear billing statement if we spin up a Dedicated pool.

jordan_se: We can support that. Proposed POC config:
- Workspace: novatech-poc
- Invite flow: SSO-first, fallback to invite link with strict expiry (default 6h)
- Token model: ephemeral token scoped to workspace+role+capabilities
- Action scope: generate:chat, generate:embeddings only

nisha_security: Requirements from their compliance team:
1) No long-lived admin keys for POC (audit-only)
2) Token issuance and revocation events pushed to their SIEM (syslog/HTTP)
3) Enable IP allowlist for sensitive endpoints if they request

chao_eng: Implementation notes: we expose both a UI invite flow and the invites API. Example invite API body we give SEs to automate contractor onboards:
POST /v1/workspaces/{ws}/invites
Body:
{
  "email": "temp.contractor@vendor.com",
  "role": "poc_reader",
  "expires_in": "6h",
  "capabilities": ["generate:chat","generate:embeddings"]
}
The system returns an ephemeral link; clicking exchanges SSO assertion for the account and mints token. We also support programmatic token minting via rwctl for integration tests.

lina_sales: NovaTech asked: what happens if we provision Dedicated for POC and then they cancel early? Any prorated refunds?

jordan_se: Typical flow: Dedicated billing begins when the pool enters "active" and resources are allocated. For short POCs we can do a timeboxed Dedicated trial with credits; refunds are handled case-by-case by finance. I'll request a dev-friendly statement: "Credits cover first 30 days; otherwise standard reserved billing applies from activation."

nisha_security: Also flag: if they require CMK for token material, Hosted may require contract addendum. Private (VPC) supports customer-managed KMS by design. For the POC, offer envelope encryption with vendor-managed keys and a plan to migrate to CMK in Private if they escalate.

infra_bot: invite-service: tmpl created id=inv-tmpl-9f3, expiry=6h, scope=[generate:chat,generate:embeddings]

chao_eng: RBAC suggestion for the POC (minimal):
- poc_reader: generate:chat,generate:embeddings, read:metrics
- poc_engineer: poc_reader + manage:routes (no manage:capacity)
- poc_owner: full POC admin (limit to 1-2 people)

lina_sales: Action list:
- jordan: confirm Dedicated trial credit language with finance and post wording here
- chao: dump screenshots of invite UI + API example into the deal folder (attach)
- nisha: short SQA acceptance lines for the customer's security team

jordan_se: I'll loop finance and post the exact credit policy by EOD.

nisha_security: SQA lines (copyable): "POC tokens are short-lived (<=6h); issuance and revocation are logged and exported to the customer's SIEM; Hosted default uses vendor-managed envelope encryption. Customer-managed KMS supported in Private/VPC deployments; CMK for Hosted requires contracting."

lina_sales: thanks all. I'll send this to NovaTech and ask if they want the Dedicated trial.
